items.title: CVE-2026-135620: The Relevanssi – A Better Search plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 4.28.9. This is due to the plugin not properly ver
items.summary: The Relevanssi – A Better Search plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 4.28.9. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to use the found_posts count in the JSON response as a boolean exact-match oracle to confirm specific post meta key/value pairs and enumerate which published posts carry a given meta key, including private underscore-prefixed meta such as API keys, tokens, and plugin configuration secrets.

items.title: CVE-2026-131806: The CubeWP Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'cwp_custom_form[form_data_id]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.13 du
items.summary: The CubeWP Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'cwp_custom_form[form_data_id]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.13 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The nonce required by the submission handler is publicly emitted in the inline script data of any page rendering the cwpCustomForm shortcode, making it trivially obtainable by unauthenticated visitors and rendering the nonce check ineffective as an authentication barrier.

items.title: CVE-2026-132207: The Broken Link Notifier plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content_links[] / header_links[] / footer_links[]' parameter in all ve
items.summary: The Broken Link Notifier plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content_links[] / header_links[] / footer_links[]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.0.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The script executes in the administrator's wp-admin session only when the administrator clicks the Replace Link action on the injected row, meaning successful exploitation requires tricking an administrator into performing that action. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

items.summary: The Xagio SEO & AEO – AI SEO for Google Rankings & AI Visibility plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (metakeyinput=XAGIO_SEO_SCRIPTS_HEADER)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.0.54 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. items.title: CVE-2026-130045: The WP Optin Wheel – Gamified Optin Email Marketing Tool for WordPress and WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_fields[].va
items.summary: The WP Optin Wheel – Gamified Optin Email Marketing Tool for WordPress and WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_fields[].value (XML-RPC wp.newPost -> post meta 'options' -> JSON->theme)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. The payload is stored via the XML-RPC wp.newPost endpoint, which bypasses Admin_Controller::sanitize_options() entirely because the CPT inherits default 'post' capabilities, making any Author-level account sufficient to write the malicious 'theme' value.

items.title: CVE-2026-130050: The WP Optin Wheel – Gamified Optin Email Marketing Tool for WordPress and WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_fields[opti
items.summary: The WP Optin Wheel – Gamified Optin Email Marketing Tool for WordPress and WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_fields[options] -> fields[].placeholder' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. The wof_lite_wheel custom post type inherits standard post capabilities due to an unset capability_type, meaning any Author-level user can publish a malicious wheel via XML-RPC in a single request, exposing every front-end page that renders the wheel to all visitors.

items.title: CVE-2026-130056: The W4 Post List plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (for metakeyinput= )' parameter in all versions up to, and
items.summary: The W4 Post List plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (for metakeyinput= )' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the attacker's post to be included in the W4 Post List query and the active list template to reference the attacker's chosen meta key via a [post_meta key="..."] tag; because WordPress core applies no kses filtering to custom field values on save, a raw XSS payload is preserved in the database unmodified and rendered verbatim on every page load.

items.title: CVE-2026-131613: The Classified Listing – AI-Powered Business Directory & Classified Ads plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'formData[description]' parameter
items.summary: The Classified Listing – AI-Powered Business Directory & Classified Ads plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'formData[description]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. Exploitation by unauthenticated attackers requires that the admin option 'post-for-unregister' is enabled (Functions::is_enable_post_for_unregister() returns true). On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with subscriber-level access and above.

items.title: CVE-2026-131688: The Secure MCP Server for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor and other AI Agents plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.8
items.summary: The Secure MCP Server for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor and other AI Agents plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.8 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for attackers (with access to a valid MCP bearer token) to escalate privileges to the token owner's Administrator role — bypassing NHI ability allow-list and scope restrictions entirely — by submitting any valid MCP bearer token (including scope-restricted connection-test tokens) to arbitrary WordPress endpoints such as admin-ajax.php. This requires possession of a valid MCP bearer token, which is routinely issued to any administrator who connects an MCP client to the site. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive the complete Administrator role.

items.title: CVE-2026-120570: The Enfold theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'templateName' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.3.1 due to insufficient input s
items.summary: The Enfold theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'templateName' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.3.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The AJAX save handler validates a nonce and requires only the edit_posts capability, meaning a Contributor can legitimately obtain the nonce from their own post-edit screen and store a malicious template name that subsequently fires in every privileged user's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-122065: The MoreConvert Wishlist for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'empty_icon' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.
items.summary: The MoreConvert Wishlist for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'empty_icon' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is exploitable even in version 2.0.4 where a patch was attempted, because the sanitizer's single html_entity_decode pass combined with esc_attr()'s double_encode=false behavior leaves entity-encoded inner markup intact, which the counter JavaScript then decodes and assigns to innerHTML, turning inert encoded text back into executable DOM elements.

items.title: CVE-2026-123175: The plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_text (shortcode attribute of [vc_cta])' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 du
items.summary: The plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_text (shortcode attribute of [vc_cta])' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. The style="classic" shortcode attribute must be used to trigger the vulnerable code path that feeds custom_text through vc_get_css_color into the inline style attribute; wp_kses_post applied at save time does not neutralize the payload because the attacker's value contains no HTML tags, only a double quote inside a shortcode attribute, leaving the injected content intact in post_content.

items.title: CVE-2026-125293: The WPMR Google Feed Manager for WooCommerce – Sell on Google Merchant Center & Shopping plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'feed (
items.summary: The WPMR Google Feed Manager for WooCommerce – Sell on Google Merchant Center & Shopping plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'feed (title field inside the JSON-encoded feed array)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.24.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. items.title: CVE-2026-128096: The Advanced Custom Fields: Font Awesome Field plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'acf[field_klzacffa_iconcls] (profile.php) / acf.profile_ic
items.summary: The Advanced Custom Fields: Font Awesome Field plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'acf[field_klzacffa_iconcls] (profile.php) / acf.profile_icon_class (REST)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.2.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. items.title: CVE-2026-128111: The Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'upload-file' parameter in all versions up to, a
items.summary: The Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'upload-file' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. items.title: CVE-2026-119630: The Timetics – Appointment Booking Calendar & Scheduling System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data and user account creation in versions up to,
items.summary: The Timetics – Appointment Booking Calendar & Scheduling System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data and user account creation in versions up to, and including, 1.0.67 This is due to the public `POST /wp-json/timetics/v1/bookings` route being registered with `permission_callback => function () { return true; }` and the handler (`create_item()` → `save_bookings()` → `booking_appointment()`) passing the attacker-controlled `email` directly into `Customer::make()`, which (a) grants the `timetics-customer` role to any existing WordPress user matched by email — including administrators and staff — and overwrites that account's `first_name`/`last_name` user meta, and (b) calls `wp_insert_user()` with role `timetics-customer` when the email is new, regardless of the site's `users_can_register` setting. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to create arbitrary WordPress user accounts, assign the `timetics-customer` role to existing accounts (including administrators), and overwrite their profile metadata.

items.summary: The Duplicate Post plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'data[custom][names][prefix]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. items.title: CVE-2026-120120: The AutomatorWP – No-Code Workflow Automation, Integration & Webhooks Plugin, now with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'post_field_conditions
items.summary: The AutomatorWP – No-Code Workflow Automation, Integration & Webhooks Plugin, now with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'post_field_conditions[0][field]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.1.2 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. items.title: CVE-2026-135203: In Eclipse Ditto versions 0.3.0-M1 through 3.8.15 and 3.9.0 through 3.9.9, the JavaScript payload mapper of the connectivity service executes user-supplied mapping scripts in a Moz
items.summary: In Eclipse Ditto versions 0.3.0-M1 through 3.8.15 and 3.9.0 through 3.9.9, the JavaScript payload mapper of the connectivity service executes user-supplied mapping scripts in a Mozilla Rhino engine without a ClassShutter. items.title: CVE-2026-133472: The CubeWP Framework plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.32 This is due to the `cubewp_frontend_role_caps()` functi
items.summary: The CubeWP Framework plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.32 This is due to the `cubewp_frontend_role_caps()` function, registered on the `user_has_cap` filter, which excludes REST API requests via a `REST_REQUEST` guard but omits a corresponding `XMLRPC_REQUEST` check, causing it to unconditionally widen capabilities for any Subscriber or Contributor on XML-RPC and admin-ajax.php request paths. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access and above to escalate their privileges to the full Contributor role capability set — gaining `edit_posts`, `delete_posts`, and `read` — allowing them to create, edit, and delete posts through core XML-RPC methods such as `wp.newPost`. Critically, the capability widening is not scoped to CubeWP's own submission handlers but applies globally to all core capability gates on affected request paths, meaning any Subscriber account can exploit this with a single standard XML-RPC call and no CubeWP-specific interaction. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive every capability defined for the Contributor role.

items.title: CVE-2026-135148: The Download Manager plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'file[files][]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.78 due to insuffi
items.summary: The Download Manager plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'file[files][]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.78 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that the affected package uses a link template containing the [play_button] shortcode, such as the bundled 'With Audio Preview' template, since the vulnerable audioPlayer() output path is only triggered when that placeholder is rendered.

items.title: CVE-2026-135151: The Download Manager plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.78 via the 'file[page_template]' parameter parameter. This
items.summary: The Download Manager plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.78 via the 'file[page_template]' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to include and execute arbitrary .php files on the server, allowing the execution of any PHP code in those files. This can be used to bypass access controls, obtain sensitive data, or achieve code execution in cases where .php file types can be uploaded and included. The malicious page_template value is stored when an Author creates or edits a package post, and the inclusion is triggered on any subsequent page view of the package permalink, meaning the include() can be fired by unauthenticated visitors after the payload is planted.

items.title: CVE-2026-135266: The Music Player for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 1.9.4 via the '_downloadable_files' parameter param
items.summary: The Music Player for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 1.9.4 via the '_downloadable_files' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information. Staging the attack requires storing a crafted downloadable file URL against a product, which requires the edit_products capability (Shop Manager or above); however, triggering the file read via the ?wcmp-action=play handler is fully unauthenticated once the crafted URL is saved to a published product.

items.title: CVE-2026-135899: JobRouter Premium, version 2025.1.11, has a stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Favorites feature. An authenticated user with low privileges can inject JavaScrip
items.summary: JobRouter Premium, version 2025.1.11, has a stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Favorites feature. An authenticated user with low privileges can inject JavaScript code that is persistently stored on the server. When other users access the affected page, the code executes in their browsers. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to perform unauthorized actions on behalf of the victim, access sensitive information, or compromise the integrity of their sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-125933: The Funnelforms Free – Multi Step Form, Contact Form & Lead Funnel Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'document.settings.heading' par
items.summary: The Funnelforms Free – Multi Step Form, Contact Form & Lead Funnel Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'document.settings.heading' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable on standard single-site WordPress installs only when the DISALLOW_UNFILTERED_HTML constant is set, the site is a WordPress multisite network (where administrators lack the unfiltered_html capability by default), or an administrator has explicitly granted the funnelforms_edit_forms capability to a lower-privileged role. Exploitation by attackers with administrator-level access and above requires that the site is a WordPress multisite install (site admins automatically lack unfiltered_html). On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with custom-level access and above.

items.title: CVE-2026-127041: Bizum Pay for Android incorporates static values within the APK to authenticate and sign requests to its API, including those for user registration. These values are common across
items.summary: Bizum Pay for Android incorporates static values within the APK to authenticate and sign requests to its API, including those for user registration. These values are common across different installations and can be extracted from the APK. An attacker who obtains the application could reuse them to generate requests that the server accepts as authenticated. The potential scope of these requests was limited to querying auxiliary information and certain configuration statuses. Under no circumstances could they generate unauthorised payments via Bizum Pay, nor could they carry out illegitimate activations of the app (which always require access to the customer’s banking channels, thereby protecting them from this type of potential vulnerability). Furthermore, requests are always limited to a set number of attempts and are closely monitored to prevent potential mass queries. The correction implemented uses site-specific material and removes support for the previous format in the backend. Consequently, previous versions are no longer operational for the services affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-131589: The AI Engine – MCP Server & AI Chatbot for WordPress, with Claude, ChatGPT & Gemini plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Limited Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and
items.summary: The AI Engine – MCP Server & AI Chatbot for WordPress, with Claude, ChatGPT & Gemini plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Limited Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 3.9.4 via the `url` parameter of the `/mwai/v1/helpers/create_image` REST API endpoint. The vulnerability exists because the `add_image_from_url()` function applies the `get_allowed_mime_types()` extension allow-list only on the custom-filename branch; when the request omits a `filename` value, the empty-filename branch derives the stored file's extension directly from the URL basename via `sanitize_file_name()` without any MIME or extension validation, then writes the downloaded response body verbatim to the WordPress uploads directory via `file_put_contents()`. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers with Editor-level access and above to place attacker-controlled HTML, SVG, or JavaScript files into `wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/` under an attacker-chosen extension, enabling stored cross-site scripting against any administrator who opens the resulting attachment URL. items.title: CVE-2026-131687: The ShopMagic – email automation for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature in all versions up to, and including, 4.9.5 Al
items.summary: The ShopMagic – email automation for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature in all versions up to, and including, 4.9.5 Although `CurrentCustomer::encode_tracking_data()` appends an md5 hash to the `shopmagic_visitor_ ` cookie to make it tamper-resistant, `CookiePersistence::get_tracking_data()` returns the raw `json_decode()`'d cookie value directly without computing or verifying that hash, leaving the cookie's `user_id`, `email`, and `meta` fields fully under attacker control. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to forge the visitor cookie — which is predictable because its name is derived as `md5(siteurl)` from the public site URL — and submit it to the unprotected `wp_ajax_nopriv_capture_email_url` endpoint (which is registered without a nonce check or capability check) to impersonate any WordPress user including administrators in ShopMagic's customer-identity context, and to overwrite the stored profile metadata — including name, phone number, and billing address — of any existing guest record in `wp_shopmagic_guest` and `wp_shopmagic_guest_meta` via `GuestManager::save()`.

items.title: CVE-2026-120493: The Widgets for Social Photo Feed plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'widget-id' shortcode attribute of the [trustindex-feed] shortcode in ve
items.summary: The Widgets for Social Photo Feed plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'widget-id' shortcode attribute of the [trustindex-feed] shortcode in versions up to, and including, 1.8.3 This is due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping in the registerWidget() function, which concatenates the raw shortcode attribute directly into a double-quoted JavaScript string literal that is then enqueued via wp_add_inline_script() and rendered in wp_footer/admin_footer. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

items.title: CVE-2026-120542: The theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (via wp-admin/post.php add_meta → post_meta key 'my_field')' parameter in all versions up to
items.summary: The theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (via wp-admin/post.php add_meta → post_meta key 'my_field')' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. A Contributor can store a raw script payload in a custom field on their own draft and cause it to execute in an administrator's or editor's authenticated browser session when they preview or publish the post.

items.title: CVE-2026-122298: The Beautiful taxonomy filters plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'term_name (reflected from DB)' parameter in all versions up to, and includ
items.summary: The Beautiful taxonomy filters plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'term_name (reflected from DB)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.6.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires an attacker to first create a maliciously-named taxonomy term as an Author-level user; the nonce required to trigger execution is publicly emitted on any front-end page displaying the taxonomy filter widget, making the injected payload reachable by completely unauthenticated visitors.

items.title: CVE-2026-124211: The Ninja Tables – Responsive Table Builder for Data, Pricing & Product Tables plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to SQL Injection via the 'dateFormat' column metadata parameter in
items.summary: The Ninja Tables – Responsive Table Builder for Data, Pricing & Product Tables plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to SQL Injection via the 'dateFormat' column metadata parameter in versions up to, and including, 5.5.1 This is due to insufficient escaping on the stored 'dateFormat' value in DefaultProvider::orderByJsonQuery(); convertDateFormatToMysql() only performs str_replace on date-format tokens and leaves SQL metacharacters (including single quotes) intact, after which the value is concatenated directly into an orderByRaw() ORDER BY clause inside single quotes. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database; the payload is stored in the _ninja_table_columns post meta and executed on every unauthenticated request to the wp_ajax_ninja_tables_public_action AJAX endpoint when the table uses sorting_type='by_column' with a date column.

items.summary: Pydantic AI Harness's PlaywrightBrowser applies an egress policy to the requests a page makes. It treated any URL containing a backslash as having no host, and it allows script and asset requests with no host. A page script could therefore add a backslash to a URL's query to send requests to private addresses, to hosts outside allowed_domains, and to hosts in blocked_domains. This affects applications that use PlaywrightBrowser to open pages or follow instructions an attacker can influence. It applies to fetch, XHR, sendBeacon, WebSocket and passive asset requests. Navigation and frames were not affected. A policy that limits every request kind to an allowlist did not prevent data from being sent to another host. Responses from private services could be read only when the service permits cross-origin reads or accepts the WebSocket connection. Current Chromium versions separately block many requests from public pages to private addresses, but not requests between public hosts, and not when the browser runs behind a forward proxy. items.title: CVE-2026-129838: A flaw was found in rsyslog. This vulnerability allows a local user to spoof sender identity and cause downstream log consumers to misattribute event origins. When the imuxsock mod
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. This vulnerability allows a local user to spoof sender identity and cause downstream log consumers to misattribute event origins. When the imuxsock module is configured with plain trusted-property annotation, it fails to properly escape process names and executable paths in log metadata. A local attacker can exploit this issue by sending log messages through the local log socket with crafted process names to inject forged identity attributes.

items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, unauthenticated request parameters in ad delivery can cause reflected cross-site scripting. items.title: CVE-2026-136949: A weakness has been identified in nliautaud pico-content-editor up to 02d5ad6c820c5050c542ab9505819b5e0a0ba1af. The affected element is the function getLanguageContent of the file
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in nliautaud pico-content-editor up to 02d5ad6c820c5050c542ab9505819b5e0a0ba1af. The affected element is the function getLanguageContent of the file src/EditorsHandlers/ContentTools.php of the component ContentTools Editor. This manipulation of the argument ContentToolsUrl causes server-side request forgery. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Continious delivery with rolling releases is used by this product. Therefore, no version details of affected nor updated releases are available. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

items.title: CVE-2026-122263: Kestra is an open-source control plane for workflows across data, infrastructure, and applications. Prior to version 2.0.1, the namespace-files export endpoint places an unvalidate
items.summary: Kestra is an open-source control plane for workflows across data, infrastructure, and applications. Prior to version 2.0.1, the namespace-files export endpoint places an unvalidated namespace path segment into the Content-Disposition filename of the ZIP download. An attacker who tricks a user into following a crafted export URL can inject Content-Disposition header parameters to spoof the saved filename or extension. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-115576: NetBird is a zero-trust networking platform that connects people, machines, and AI agents across any network. From versions 0.5.0 through 0.75.1, the client daemon exposes its gRPC
items.summary: NetBird is a zero-trust networking platform that connects people, machines, and AI agents across any network. From versions 0.5.0 through 0.75.1, the client daemon exposes its gRPC control interface to any local process without authentication. On Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD, the interface is a Unix domain socket that is accessible to all local users, allowing any of them to control the daemon. An attacker with a low-privilege account can read or modify privileged VPN and daemon settings, disconnect or hijack the NetBird peer, and gain an unauthenticated root shell via the built-in SSH server. This issue is fixed in version 0.76.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-52803: Gogs is an open source self-hosted Git service. Prior to 0.15.0, Gogs does not regenerate the session ID after successful authentication. An attacker who forces a victim to use a k
items.summary: Gogs is an open source self-hosted Git service. Prior to 0.15.0, Gogs does not regenerate the session ID after successful authentication. An attacker who forces a victim to use a known session ID can hijack the session after the victim logs in and take over the account. This issue is fixed in version 0.15.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-66784: A flaw was found in Submariner. In its default Pre-Shared Key (PSK) mode, all gateways within a broker set utilize the same PSK. An attacker, by knowing this shared PSK, can forge
items.summary: A flaw was found in Submariner. In its default Pre-Shared Key (PSK) mode, all gateways within a broker set utilize the same PSK. An attacker, by knowing this shared PSK, can forge an Endpoint Custom Resource (CR) to impersonate another cluster's identity. This enables the attacker to establish an Internet Protocol Security (IPsec) tunnel under the false identity, leading to a Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attack on network traffic between clusters.

items.title: CVE-2026-114507: LightRAG provides simple and fast retrieval-augmented generation. Prior to 1.5.5, query responses are cached under a key that omits conversation_history, so an unauthenticated atta
items.summary: LightRAG provides simple and fast retrieval-augmented generation. This issue is fixed in version 1.5.5.

items.summary: Crypt::JWT versions before 0.037_1 for Perl compare HMAC signatures and JWE authentication tags in non-constant time. decode_jwt compares HS256, HS384 and HS512 signatures, and the authentication tag of A128CBC-HS256, A192CBC-HS384 and A256CBC-HS512 encrypted tokens, against the computed value with Perl's eq operator. items.summary: Crypt::JWT versions before 0.037_1 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via unbounded inflation of zip DEF payloads. items.title: CVE-2026-136796: Crypt::JWT versions before 0.037_1 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via an unbounded PBES2 iteration count. For a token using a PBES2 key management algorithm, decode_jwt passes the
items.summary: Crypt::JWT versions before 0.037_1 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via an unbounded PBES2 iteration count. items.title: CVE-2026-136510: A parameter-array execution that fails part-way leaves the rows it has already queued on the statement handle, and the next execution on that handle sends them. After a data-at-exe
items.summary: A parameter-array execution that fails part-way leaves the rows it has already queued on the statement handle, and the next execution on that handle sends them. After a data-at-execution batch is abandoned, by SQLCancel or a rejected SQLPutData, the next SQLExecDirect sends the failed batch's rows and returns SQL_SUCCESS without sending its own statement. So an application that logs the failure on the same handle has its log entry turned into a silent no-op, while rows it was told had failed are stored. An end user who controls one value in an application's array insert can arrange both halves of that. A second route needs no data-at-execution parameter: when building a later row fails in parameter conversion, the queued rows go to the server ahead of the next parameter array on the handle, inside whatever transaction and session settings are current by then. One variant also writes past the end of a shorter SQL_ATTR_PARAM_STATUS_PTR array supplied by the next statement. The statements that run are the application's own, correctly quoted; no SQL text comes from outside. Versions from psqlODBC 12.02.0000, which introduced batched parameter-array execution, up to and including 18.00.

items.title: CVE-2026-136511: psqlODBC mapped an SSLmode value in a connection string that it did not recognise, such as SSLmode=Require, SSLmode=Verify-Full, SSLmode={require} or SSLmode={verify-full}, to disa
items.summary: psqlODBC mapped an SSLmode value in a connection string that it did not recognise, such as SSLmode=Require, SSLmode=Verify-Full, SSLmode={require} or SSLmode={verify-full}, to disable. SQLDriverConnect() then returned SQL_SUCCESS with no diagnostic, and the connection was not encrypted. An attacker on the network path of such a connection can read and change its traffic. Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

items.summary: With SQL_C_DEFAULT, the C type of a bound column or parameter follows its SQL type. An application sizes its buffer from the type it was told when it described the statement. When the column had another type at fetch time, because the server reported another type, the table was altered, or an output parameter's result column had another type, psqlODBC wrote the larger type into the smaller buffer: 12 bytes past a 4-byte buffer for a uuid, and more in multi-row fetches, where the driver also steps through the array by the larger size. items.title: CVE-2026-136513: When Debug or CommLog is enabled and the log directory cannot be used, psqlODBC falls back to a directory under the user's home directory. It wrote that path with an unexpanded ~,
items.summary: When Debug or CommLog is enabled and the log directory cannot be used, psqlODBC falls back to a directory under the user's home directory. It wrote that path with an unexpanded ~, which is resolved relative to the process's current directory. Another local user who controls a directory on that path can make the driver create the victim's mylog_*.log and psqlodbc_*.log files in any directory the victim can write to, or leave the victim's process blocked in open(). This completes the fix for CVE-2026-120066 in 18.00.0006. Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

items.summary: psqlODBC assumed that a table it reads keeps the definition it had when the statement was described or parsed. items.summary: psqlODBC rewrites statement text for keyset-driven cursors and ODBC escapes using positions it found in the text. items.summary: To build positioned updates and to describe columns, psqlODBC matches the names in a statement against the catalog. items.summary: psqlODBC scans statement text itself to substitute parameters, translate ODBC escapes, join batched statements and rewrite queries for updatable cursors. items.title: CVE-2026-136503: psqlODBC frees memory that is still in use, frees it twice, or writes outside an application buffer in these cases: - The clean-up the driver runs at commit and rollback sends que
items.summary: psqlODBC frees memory that is still in use, frees it twice, or writes outside an application buffer in these cases: - The clean-up the driver runs at commit and rollback sends queries of its own, and the reply to one of them can start the clean-up again while it is running. items.title: CVE-2026-136504: With the driver's debug log (MyLog) turned on, two paths write the database password to the log in clear text, both beside a line where the driver's own redaction masks it as PWD=x
items.summary: With the driver's debug log (MyLog) turned on, two paths write the database password to the log in clear text, both beside a line where the driver's own redaction masks it as PWD=xxxxx: - Pressing "Test" in the Windows data source setup dialog (psqlsetup.dll) logs the whole connection string, which carries PWD= percent-encoded, which is reversible, and any password= or sslpassword= inside pqopt. - The Unicode connect functions SQLDriverConnectW, SQLConnectW and SQLBrowseConnectW log their arguments as they convert them between UTF-16 and UTF-8, before the masking happens. The ANSI entry points are unaffected. Turning the log on takes an administrator, and MyLog is off by default. The exposure is the person who later reads the log, which in practice means a log attached to a bug report or handed to support. Making that safe is the purpose of the driver's redaction, and these two sites bypassed it. Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

items.summary: psqlODBC uses sizes and counts without checking their range, or keeps them in types too small for them: - A row array size of 0, set with SQLSetStmtAttr() or on the ARD, makes SQLSetPos() with SQL_REFRESH write past the bound arrays. - SQL_DESC_COUNT above 32767 on an APD or IPD writes before the start of a heap buffer. - A numeric parameter with a negative scale overflows a stack buffer. - SQLGetData() of a text value of 2 GiB or more into a wide-character buffer computes a wrapped size and overflows the heap. - The 16-bit reference count and size of the statement parser's column-information cache wrap, which frees a cache entry still in use or overflows the cache, and a statement with more than 32768 columns overflows the parser's field array. - An updatable cursor that records more than 65535 changes in one transaction wraps the 16-bit capacity of its rollback log, which overflows it and frees it twice. - A statement with 32769 or more parameter markers overflows a 16-bit parameter count. - A wide-character string of more than 2 GiB wraps the size of its UTF-8 conversion, which is then written below the start of a heap buffer. - SQLGetDiagField() and SQLGetDiagFieldW() always st

items.summary: psqlODBC builds queries of its own from names, and put these names into them without escaping or qualification: - the database name in SQLForeignKeys(); - the current schema name in catalog functions; - the table name in the currtid2() call that re-reads rows of updatable cursors; - column names in the inserts and updates of SQLSetPos() and SQLBulkOperations(); - cursor names set with SQLSetCursorName() or returned as refcursors (FetchRefcursors=1); - parameter names (SQL_DESC_NAME) in procedure calls; - the = operator in an OID comparison in SQLColumns(), which the server resolves through search_path. items.title: CVE-2026-136507: psqlODBC parsed and built connection strings in ways that let a value end early: - In a braced value, such as PWD={…}, a trailing byte 0x7d of a GBK, Big5 or SJIS character was ta
items.summary: psqlODBC parsed and built connection strings in ways that let a value end early: - In a braced value, such as PWD={…}, a trailing byte 0x7d of a GBK, Big5 or SJIS character was taken for the closing brace. - A braced value that ended right after an escaped }} was not reported as unterminated, and its contents were parsed as further keywords. - SQLConnectW(), SQLDriverConnectW() and SQLBrowseConnectW() cut a connection string whose UTF-8 form is longer than 32767 bytes, which changes how the rest of it is parsed. - On Windows with MSDTC, the password and user name were put into the XA open string without escaping, and the XA library copied each item of that string into a 64-byte stack buffer. - Percent-encoding a long password wrote one byte past a 4096-byte stack buffer. items.title: CVE-2026-136508: On Windows, when a connection takes part in a distributed transaction, psqlODBC and its XA library open further connections of their own to finish the transaction. These connection
items.summary: On Windows, when a connection takes part in a distributed transaction, psqlODBC and its XA library open further connections of their own to finish the transaction. These connections did not keep the security settings of the application's connection: - When the XA library's first connection attempt failed, it tried again with sslmode=allow, even for a data source configured with sslmode=verify-full or verify-ca. - The connections the driver opens itself ignored every libpq option given through pqopt, such as channel_binding=require, and the open string it registers with MSDTC carried no pqopt, so the XA library's connections dropped those options too. An attacker on the network path between the MSDTC host and the PostgreSQL server, without a certificate or credentials, can make those connections go to a server of their choosing without TLS, read and change what they send, and decide the outcome MSDTC records for the transaction. Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-135092: PDF::API2 versions before 2.049 for Perl allow unbounded recursion via circular cross-reference chains in readxrtr. When a PDF is opened, readxrtr reads each cross-reference table
items.summary: PDF::API2 versions before 2.049 for Perl allow unbounded recursion via circular cross-reference chains in readxrtr. When a PDF is opened, readxrtr reads each cross-reference table and calls itself on the offset in the trailer's /Prev entry. Nothing records which offsets it has already read, so a /Prev entry pointing back to an earlier table, or to its own, makes it recurse without end. An attacker who supplies a crafted PDF can cause a denial of service in any application that opens it.

items.title: CVE-2026-136500: To escape a bound parameter, or a name passed to a catalog function, psqlODBC has to know where each multibyte character of the client encoding ends. It treated a client encoding n
items.summary: To escape a bound parameter, or a name passed to a catalog function, psqlODBC has to know where each multibyte character of the client encoding ends. It treated a client encoding named by an alias the server accepts, such as WIN950, Windows950 or big-5 for BIG5, as single-byte, and it accepted too narrow a range of lead bytes for JOHAB, EUC_TW, EUC_CN and EUC_KR. A quote byte that the server reads as part of such a character was then not doubled, or a quote the server reads on its own was taken for part of a character, and the literal ended early. An end user who controls one bound character parameter, or a name the application passes to a catalog function such as SQLTables(), can run SQL with the rights of the application's database role. This requires a connection that is not in UTF-8: the ANSI driver, or the ANSI entry points, with one of these client encodings. For bound parameters the driver must also be substituting parameters itself, as it does with UseServerSidePrepare=0 or a cursor type other than forward-only. Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

items.summary: A flaw was found in ironic-image. items.summary: The Grow R502-A fingerprint sensor driver (drivers/sensor/grow_r502a/grow_r502a.c) receives sensor responses in the UART interrupt handler uart_cb_handler(). The existing length check in r502a_validate_rx_packet() runs only after the data has been written, so it does not prevent the overflow. items.summary: ChargePoint Home Flex dwnldlogsm tar Command Injection Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the tar function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-29057.

items.title: CVE-2026-102957: z_impl_pwm_capture_cycles() in drivers/pwm/pwm_capture.c stores its capture context (struct z_pwm_capture_cb_data, including a struct k_sem) on its own stack and registers a pointe
items.summary: z_impl_pwm_capture_cycles() in drivers/pwm/pwm_capture.c stores its capture context (struct z_pwm_capture_cb_data, including a struct k_sem) on its own stack and registers a pointer to it as the driver capture callback's user_data. When called with a K_NO_WAIT timeout, k_sem_take() returns -EBUSY, which the function did not handle: it fell through, returned the uninitialized status field, copied uninitialized period/pulse values to the caller when that status happened to be zero, and returned without disabling the capture or clearing the callback. pwm_capture_cycles() is a system call, and z_vrfy_pwm_capture_cycles() passes the caller's timeout through unchanged. With CONFIG_USERSPACE and CONFIG_PWM_CAPTURE enabled, an unprivileged user-mode thread that has been granted access to a capture-capable PWM device can pass K_NO_WAIT to trigger the defect. Without userspace the function is only reachable from trusted application code. The uninitialized values come from the thread's privileged (kernel) stack, so a user-mode caller can read up to 8 bytes of stale kernel stack memory per call. items.title: CVE-2026-102959: The Grow R502-A fingerprint sensor driver (drivers/sensor/grow_r502a/grow_r502a.c) points drv_data->rx_buf.data at an rx_packet buffer on the caller's stack and enables the UART RX
items.summary: The Grow R502-A fingerprint sensor driver (drivers/sensor/grow_r502a/grow_r502a.c) points drv_data->rx_buf.data at an rx_packet buffer on the caller's stack and enables the UART RX interrupt before waiting 1500 ms for a reply. When the wait timed out, transceive_packet() returned -ETIMEDOUT but left the RX interrupt enabled and rx_buf.data still pointing at the caller's buffer. Once the caller's frame has returned, any bytes that arrive late on the UART are written by the interrupt handler uart_cb_handler() through the dangling pointer into stack memory that the thread has since reused. The bytes come from the device on the other end of the UART. An attacker with physical access who replaces or impersonates the fingerprint module can trigger this by delaying a reply past the timeout and then sending a packet. A slow or faulty genuine module can also trigger it by accident. The result is a write of attacker-chosen bytes into a live thread stack. The write length comes from the header of the late packet. items.title: Cisco Informational for Emergency Distrust of eMudhra Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities
items.summary: Between October 17 and October 20, 2026, a critical security compromise involving Certificate Authorities that are managed by eMudhra was uncovered. A security researcher demonstrated that the private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were fundamentally broken due to an unprecedented error in their Key Generation Ceremony (KGC) in April 2025. This allows anyone to brute-force acquire these private keys within seconds. For more information, see eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise and the Cisco Talos blog post Compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates . For information about Splunk products and offerings, see Compromised eMudhra Intermediate Certificate Authorities on Splunk Products - October 2026 . Important: If a product is not listed within this advisory, Cisco's review indicates that the product is not affected by this vulnerability. This advisory is available at the following link: https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-emudhra-info-ScS22A1r Security Impact Rating: Informational

This vulnerability affects the function BuildToken of the file src/Equinox.Services.Api/appsettings.Development.json of the component JWT Bearer Authentication. This manipulation of the argument SecretKey with the input fmFGn5agHZkuG2N0e1zaEJIQtGVoNN5P causes hard-coded credentials. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.summary: Improper input validation in the AWS-managed AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook AWSConfigRemediation-EnableSystemsManagerSessionManagerAuditLogsToS3 might allow an authenticated remote user who is permitted to run the runbook to set unintended configuration in the account's Regional Session Manager preferences document (SSM-SessionManagerRunShell) via a crafted S3KeyPrefix parameter value. This applies only when that document does not already exist in the Region. The unintended configuration can include arbitrary commands, which then run on managed instances when other users start Session Manager sessions. Because any user permitted to run the runbook selects which revision to run, this issue remains reachable in an affected Region until earlier revisions can no longer be run there. AWS is deprecating all revisions created before 2026-10-22 (UTC) in every Region and partition beginning January 15, 2027; until deprecation, earlier revisions remain runnable, so upgrading alone is not sufficient. items.title: CVE-2026-133466: OpenEXR is the reference implementation and specification for the EXR image format, widely used in the motion picture industry. From versions 3.4.0 through 3.4.18 and 3.5.0 through
items.summary: OpenEXR is the reference implementation and specification for the EXR image format, widely used in the motion picture industry. From versions 3.4.0 through 3.4.18 and 3.5.0 through 3.5.2, decoding a crafted HT-compressed EXR chunk can cause ht_undo_impl() to write a 4-byte pixel value through a pointer that is not 4-byte aligned. This happens when the channels sum to a bytes-per-scanline stride that is not a multiple of four. This issue is fixed in versions 3.4.19 and 3.5.3.

items.title: CVE-2026-133467: CodeSafe is an open-source Python library for code encryption, decryption, and safe evaluation using Python's AST module. From versions 0.0.1 through 0.0.4, the safe_eval() functio
items.summary: CodeSafe is an open-source Python library for code encryption, decryption, and safe evaluation using Python's AST module. From versions 0.0.1 through 0.0.4, the safe_eval() function can be bypassed with indirect subscript calls such as builtins'exec', because AST validation blocks only direct calls to dangerous built-ins. An attacker who controls an expression passed to safe_eval() can execute arbitrary Python code with the permissions of the host application. This issue is fixed in version 0.0.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-132265: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From 0.6.49 before 0.11.0, sandbox file extraction has no
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From 0.6.49 before 0.11.0, sandbox file extraction has no cumulative byte or file-count limit. A user who can run a code-execution block that extracts files can exhaust the memory of the shared workflow executor, interrupting other users' runs on it. Each file was allowed up to 50 MB based on a size that the sandbox itself reported. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-99806: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Reject mode changes on connected channels A peer can send a configuration response with an R
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Reject mode changes on connected channels A peer can send a configuration response with an RFC option for another mode to a connected channel, for example to switch it from Streaming to ERTM mode. l2cap_parse_conf_rsp() then changes chan->mode, but l2cap_ertm_init() is not called again, so the ERTM sequence lists are never allocated. The next out-of-sequence I-frame makes l2cap_seq_list_clear() write through the NULL srej_list.list. Refuse the channel when a response tries to change the mode of a connected channel.

items.title: CVE-2026-99807: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Reject invalid TxWindow in configuration requests A peer can send an ERTM RFC option with a
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Reject invalid TxWindow in configuration requests A peer can send an ERTM RFC option with a TxWindow of zero, which is out of spec. It is stored in remote_tx_win unchanged and later passed to l2cap_seq_list_init(), where roundup_pow_of_two(0) is undefined. On some architectures this results in a ZERO_SIZE_PTR list and a remote kernel oops. A TxWindow above 63 is out of spec as well. With 6-bit sequence numbers we would then send more unacknowledged frames than the sequence space can tell apart. Reply with L2CAP_CONF_UNACCEPT and propose the default TxWindow instead of accepting the value, so remote_tx_win always stays within 1 to 63. Keep the parameters of an earlier request then, and do not treat the request as done because an earlier one was. Also refuse a zero size in l2cap_seq_list_init(), so any other path that reaches it with a zero TxWindow fails the channel instead of the kernel.

items.title: CVE-2026-99808: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Use default TxWindow for zero socket option L2CAP_OPTIONS accepts a txwin_size of zero and s
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: Bluetooth: L2CAP: Use default TxWindow for zero socket option L2CAP_OPTIONS accepts a txwin_size of zero and stores it in tx_win. The zero is then sent to the peer in our configuration request, and if the channel ends up in ERTM mode it is passed to l2cap_seq_list_init(). Use the default TxWindow instead, as the mode can still be changed to ERTM during configuration.

items.title: CVE-2026-99809: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: vfio/platform: prevent read-only region mappings from becoming writable vfio_platform_mmap() rejects writable
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: vfio/platform: prevent read-only region mappings from becoming writable vfio_platform_mmap() rejects writable mappings of regions without the WRITE flag, but leaves VM_MAYWRITE set. Userspace can map such a region read-only and then upgrade the mapping to writable with mprotect(). Clear VM_MAYWRITE for regions without the WRITE flag, as i915 does for its read-only objects and as fixed in drm/vc4 (CVE-2026-68445), drm/panthor (CVE-2024-53071) and commit a5edadbae57e ("ptp: vmclock: prevent read-only mappings from becoming writable"). Note this is defensive hardening: no in-tree platform driver currently publishes a region without the WRITE flag. The guard costs nothing and keeps the mmap() interface honest if a read-only region ever appears.

items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: vfio/fsl-mc: prevent read-only region mappings from becoming writable vfio_fsl_mc_mmap() rejects writable mappings of regions without the WRITE flag, but leaves VM_MAYWRITE set. Userspace can map such a region read-only and then upgrade the mapping to writable with mprotect(). Clear VM_MAYWRITE for regions without the WRITE flag, as i915 does for its read-only objects and as fixed in drm/vc4 (CVE-2026-68445), drm/panthor (CVE-2024-53071) and commit a5edadbae57e ("ptp: vmclock: prevent read-only mappings from becoming writable"). items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: vfio/cdx: prevent read-only region mappings from becoming writable vfio_cdx_mmap() rejects writable mappings of regions without the WRITE flag, but leaves VM_MAYWRITE set. items.title: CVE-2026-99805: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: net: limit priority VLAN untag depth The priority VLAN receive path can repeatedly remove VID 0 tags and retry
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: net: limit priority VLAN untag depth The priority VLAN receive path can repeatedly remove VID 0 tags and retry packet processing. Unlike the read-only VLAN protocol parser, this path has no limit on the number of nested tags it consumes. Each skb_vlan_untag() advances skb->data and resets header offsets. The offsets are stored in 16-bit fields. With enough nested tags, the network or transport offset can wrap. A later protocol handler can then derive a large pull length from the wrapped offsets and access memory outside the skb allocation. Apply the existing VLAN_MAX_DEPTH limit to the exceptional VID 0 retry. Count the tag already stored in skb VLAN metadata as the first level, then stop before untagging a ninth level. Keep the accounting inside this uncommon branch so the regular VLAN receive path is unaffected. A single VID 0 priority tag before a real VLAN tag is valid. No normal deployment was found that intentionally emits multiple consecutive VID 0 tags; permitting eight levels is therefore conservative. The issue was found while researching the Linux network receive path for Google kvmCTF, with OpenAI Codex

items.title: CVE-2026-77230: Camunda 8.8.0 before 8.8.47, 8.9.0 before 8.9.29, 8.10.0 before 8.10.10, and 8.11.0-alpha1 contain an insecure deserialization vulnerability in the persistent web session feature,
items.summary: Camunda 8.8.0 before 8.8.47, 8.9.0 before 8.9.29, 8.10.0 before 8.10.10, and 8.11.0-alpha1 contain an insecure deserialization vulnerability in the persistent web session feature, which stores session attributes as Java-serialized data in secondary storage and deserializes them via an ObjectInputStream without an ObjectInputFilter. Attackers with write access to the web session index, such as an unauthenticated Elasticsearch cluster deployed via Camunda's docker-compose files, can plant a crafted serialized object and trigger deserialization by presenting a matching session cookie, which combined with a gadget chain like the bundled Commons Collections 3.1-RC1 library can lead to code execution as the Camunda service account.

items.title: CVE-2026-135486: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-07 contained a broken object level authorization vulnerability in the PUT /api/invoice/{invoice_id}/extracted-data endpoint, which accepts a cli
items.summary: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-07 contained a broken object level authorization vulnerability in the PUT /api/invoice/{invoice_id}/extracted-data endpoint, which accepts a client-supplied extracted_data object without verifying invoice ownership, enforcing the invoice_edit permission or checking whether the invoice has been soft deleted. Authenticated attackers who know an invoice identifier can overwrite seller and buyer details, invoice identifiers, product entries, totals and custom metadata of invoices, including archived invoices marked is_deleted = 1, undermining the integrity of financial records.

items.title: CVE-2026-135487: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-15 contained a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to store markup in the profile full_name field by submitting
items.summary: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-15 contained a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to store markup in the profile full_name field by submitting a modified request directly to the backend, which persists the value without sanitization. The Contact Support workflow later inserts the stored name into the generated support email without HTML encoding, so attackers can make injected HTML and media, such as misleading banners, masked hyperlinks and external tracking resources, render in support messages received by the support team.

items.title: CVE-2026-133463: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs. Prior to version 4.46, the S3 gateway does not evaluate bucket policies on POST Object uploads, which are multipart/f
items.summary: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs. Prior to version 4.46, the S3 gateway does not evaluate bucket policies on POST Object uploads, which are multipart/form-data POST requests to the bucket. An authenticated S3 identity that a bucket policy restricts, such as to a key prefix or by source IP, can create or overwrite objects it is denied by sending the upload as a POST instead of a PUT. This issue has been fixed in version 4.46.

items.title: CVE-2026-133464: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs. Prior to version 4.46, FileStore.ValidatePassword in the SFTP server does not reject zero-length secrets before compa
items.summary: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs. Prior to version 4.46, FileStore.ValidatePassword in the SFTP server does not reject zero-length secrets before comparing them, causing an empty login password to match any account configured without one, such as public-key-only or certificate-only users. Because password authentication is enabled by default, a remote attacker who knows a valid username can log in without a key or secret and obtain an SFTP session with that user's home directory and path permissions. This issue is fixed in version 4.46.

items.title: CVE-2026-133465: Glances is an open-source system cross-platform monitoring tool. In versions prior to 4.5.7, the on-alert action command tokenizer in secure.py treats quote characters as argument
items.summary: Glances is an open-source system cross-platform monitoring tool. In versions prior to 4.5.7, the on-alert action command tokenizer in secure.py treats quote characters as argument boundaries without escaping. A monitored stat value, such as a mount point name, that is quoted in an action command template can contain a quote character that breaks out of its quote boundary and injects additional arguments into the process the action invokes. No shell operator is needed for this attack. This issue has been fixed in version 4.5.7.

items.title: Cisco UCS and UCS-Based Appliances UEFI Shell Secure Boot Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: A vulnerability in the Unified Extensible Firmware Interface (UEFI) Shell implementation of Cisco UCS Servers and UCS-based appliances could allow an authenticated attacker with valid credentials for a user account with the role of user or admin or an unauthenticated attacker with physical access to an affected device to bypass UEFI Secure Boot validation checks and execute unauthorized software. This vulnerability is due to the availability of memory write commands in the UEFI Shell while UEFI Secure Boot is enabled on a device. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by selecting the UEFI Shell boot option at boot time and using available shell commands to modify UEFI memory variables. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to manipulate the preboot environment, overwrite UEFI Secure Boot-related memory values, and execute unauthorized software on the affected device. Cisco has released software updates that address this vulnerability. There are no workarounds that address this vulnerability. This advisory is available at the following link: https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-ucs-uefi-sb-bypass-eb6xC5GW Security Impa

items.title: CVE-2026-81418: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the TLV.AUTH parser of the NSE eigrp.lua library, whose length arithmetic cancels out the running r
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the TLV.AUTH parser of the NSE eigrp.lua library, whose length arithmetic cancels out the running read position. An attacker on the same layer 2 segment can send a single crafted EIGRP Update of roughly 36 bytes over unauthenticated multicast, causing unbounded table growth that exhausts the memory of the Nmap process when broadcast-eigrp-discovery.nse is running.

items.title: CVE-2026-81419: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the LSUpdate.parse function of the NSE ospf.lua library, which does not advance when it reads an LSA header with a zero
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the LSUpdate.parse function of the NSE ospf.lua library, which does not advance when it reads an LSA header with a zero length. An attacker on the same layer 2 segment can send a single spoofed, unauthenticated OSPF LS Update packet, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process as soon as broadcast-ospf2-discover.nse captures it.

items.title: CVE-2026-81412: Nmap before 7.992 contains an excessive memory allocation vulnerability in the unmarshall_array function of the NSE msrpctypes.lua library, which trusts the entry count declared by
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an excessive memory allocation vulnerability in the unmarshall_array function of the NSE msrpctypes.lua library, which trusts the entry count declared by the server. A malicious SMB server on a scanned host can declare an EntriesRead value of 0xFFFFFFFF with an empty buffer, causing a prolonged CPU spin and exhausting the memory of the Nmap process; the library is used by smb-enum-shares.nse in the default script category (-sC, -A).

items.title: CVE-2026-81413: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the inline AXFR response reader of the dns-zone-transfer.nse script, which reads the zone transfer
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the inline AXFR response reader of the dns-zone-transfer.nse script, which reads the zone transfer response without a size limit. A malicious DNS server on a scanned host can stream unbounded data over TCP port 53 after the AXFR request, causing the memory of the Nmap process to grow at the attacker's send rate until it is exhausted.

items.title: CVE-2026-81414: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the sendPacketsTCP function of the NSE dns.lua library, which reads a DNS-over-TCP response without
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the sendPacketsTCP function of the NSE dns.lua library, which reads a DNS-over-TCP response without a size limit and builds it by repeated string concatenation. A malicious DNS server on a scanned host can stream unbounded data in response to the initial SOA lookup made by dns-zone-transfer.nse, before any AXFR request is sent, causing unbounded memory growth and quadratic CPU cost in the Nmap process.

items.title: CVE-2026-81415: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the negotiate_tn3270 function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose device-type search loop does not advance when the se
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the negotiate_tn3270 function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose device-type search loop does not advance when the server sends a protocol-conformant DEVICETYPE IS response without an LU suffix. A TN3270E server on a scanned host, including a non-malicious one that sends such a response, causes a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process when tn3270-screen.nse runs, which the script-timeout option does not interrupt.

items.title: CVE-2026-81416: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the process_write function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose write loop does not advance when it processes a malform
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the process_write function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose write loop does not advance when it processes a malformed Repeat to Address (RA) order. A malicious TN3270 server on a scanned host can embed a single 6-byte malformed RA order in an ordinary screen-write data stream after a normal negotiation, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process when tn3270-screen.nse runs, which the script-timeout option does not interrupt.

items.title: CVE-2026-81417: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the dispatcher of the NSE tftp.lua library, which removes completed coroutines but not ones that ended in an error, lea
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the dispatcher of the NSE tftp.lua library, which removes completed coroutines but not ones that ended in an error, leaving a zero-yield spin. A malicious TFTP exchange reached by snmp-ios-config.nse after an SNMP write sequence can leave a dead coroutine that freezes the entire Nmap invocation, before port scanning begins for any target in the run; the hang is prevented when the script-timeout option is set.

items.title: CVE-2026-81405: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the Comm.ReceivePacket function of the NSE rpc.lua library, which buffers ONC-RPC record fragments
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the Comm.ReceivePacket function of the NSE rpc.lua library, which buffers ONC-RPC record fragments using the server-declared fragment length without an upper bound. A malicious RPC service on a scanned host can declare fragments of up to roughly 2.1GB, and up to 400 fragments per call, causing the Nmap process to exhaust memory; the read path is reached by rpcinfo.nse during version detection (-sV) and is shared by the NFS, rusers and NetWorker scripts.

items.title: CVE-2026-81406: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the read_db2_packet function of the db2-das-info.nse script, which trusts an unmasked 32-bit length
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the read_db2_packet function of the db2-das-info.nse script, which trusts an unmasked 32-bit length field supplied by the server. A malicious DB2 Administration Server on a scanned host can declare a packet length of up to roughly 4.29GB, causing the script to buffer that much data and the Nmap process to exhaust memory; the script runs during version detection (-sV).

items.title: CVE-2026-81407: Nmap before 7.992 contains a hardcoded cryptographic key vulnerability in the DHCAST128 login of the NSE afp.lua library, which uses a fixed, publicly known Diffie-Hellman private
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a hardcoded cryptographic key vulnerability in the DHCAST128 login of the NSE afp.lua library, which uses a fixed, publicly known Diffie-Hellman private exponent. A passive observer of the network traffic between Nmap and an Apple Filing Protocol server can compute the shared secret from the hardcoded exponent and the server's public value and decrypt the password supplied to scripts such as afp-showmount.nse and afp-brute.nse through the afp.username and afp.password arguments, without man-in-the-middle access or cryptanalysis.

items.title: CVE-2026-81408: Nmap before 7.992 contains a loop with an unreachable exit condition in the parameter-list parsing of the NSE drda.lua library, which keeps growing its parameter list while process
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a loop with an unreachable exit condition in the parameter-list parsing of the NSE drda.lua library, which keeps growing its parameter list while processing a malicious DRDA response. A malicious DRDA service on a scanned host can make the loop consume memory without bound on 64-bit builds, exhausting the Nmap process and discarding NSE results for every other host in the same scan batch without reporting an error; the library is reached by service probes during version detection (-sV).

items.title: CVE-2026-81409: Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the http-cisco-anyconnect.nse script and the anyconnect.lua library, whose redirect handler follows a serv
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the http-cisco-anyconnect.nse script and the anyconnect.lua library, whose redirect handler follows a server-supplied redirect target without checking that it stays on the scanned host. A malicious web server on a scanned host can redirect Nmap to an arbitrary host and port, including internal and loopback addresses the attacker cannot reach directly, making Nmap send a HEAD request followed by a POST request there; response content is not returned to the attacker. The script runs in the default script category (-sC, -A).

items.title: CVE-2026-81410: Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the broadcast-upnp-info.nse script and the upnp.lua library, which fetch the device description from the L
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the broadcast-upnp-info.nse script and the upnp.lua library, which fetch the device description from the LOCATION URL in a UPnP response without checking that it points to the responding host. An attacker on the local network who answers the script's discovery broadcast can supply a LOCATION URL for an arbitrary host, port and path, including internal and loopback addresses, making Nmap send a GET request there; response content is not returned to the attacker.

items.title: CVE-2026-81411: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the ConfCreateResponse GCC block parser of the NSE rdp.lua library, which does not check that each block advances the r
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the ConfCreateResponse GCC block parser of the NSE rdp.lua library, which does not check that each block advances the read position. A malicious RDP server on a scanned host can include a single malformed zero-length block in an otherwise valid handshake, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process that the script-timeout option does not interrupt; the library is used by rdp-enum-encryption.nse in the default script category (-sC, -A).

items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in coleifer peewee up to 4.5.3. This affects the function _print_table of the file pwiz.py of the component File Import Handler. items.summary: An improper restriction of dynamically determined object attributes in the object-document mapping library's association handling allows structured input supplied in place of a simple identifier value to be turned into an object that is treated as an already-stored record of a caller-chosen model class. In applications that pass unfiltered request data into the affected association handling, an unauthenticated party may cause unintended modification or removal of stored records, and may render an individual record unreadable through that association.
